verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to give the ZCode agent custom skills for specialized tasks. The only extensibility evidence is a plugin example (Excalidraw canvas collaboration with page APIs and host integration). That describes workbench plugins, which are an adjacent feature, not agent skills. Custom skills are a fair axis for a coding agent, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks
